overview: This Senate resolution congratulates the Jackson State University Tigers football team on winning the 2024 Celebration Bowl, the yearly game between the champions of two conferences made up of Historically Black Colleges and Universities, often treated as their national title game. Jackson State, in Mississippi, beat South Carolina State 28 to 7 on December 14, 2024, winning the trophy for the first time and finishing the season 12-2. The resolution recognizes players and coach T.C. Taylor for conference honors, commends the university for its excellence in higher education, and asks that copies be sent to university leaders. It is ceremonial and does not change any law. The Senate agreed to it by unanimous consent on February 19, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution recognizes a historic first championship for the school and the achievements of its students, coaches, and HBCU athletics.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
